paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: Axion haloscope at CAPP covering 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.27-2.30 GHz). Coupling type is clearly AxionPhoton (two-photon coupling g_agamma). Reported sensitivity reaches 2.7x above KSVZ level at 90% CL. The KSVZ value at ~9.5 ueV g_agamma is roughly 2.2e-15 GeV^-1, so 2.7x is ~5.9e-15 GeV^-1; the exact numerical limit curve is not tabulated, so values are approximate estimates derived from text. Local DM density assumed rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3.
